title: Unit – 3 : Session – 5 : SLO – 2 | JDBC Architecture
sections: Fill: The JDBC API provides a DATABASE (vendor)-independent way to access databases from Java.
T/F: DriverManager manages a list of database drivers. — TRUE
MCQ: Interface between a Java application and the database driver → D) DriverManager
Fill: Class.forName("com.mysql.cj.jdbc.Driver") registers the MySQL JDBC driver manually.
Find the output: connection succeeds, con != null → A) Connected
T/F: ResultSet allows forward and backward navigation by default. — FALSE (default is forward-only)
MCQ: Interface used to execute static SQL queries → A) Statement
Fill: executeQuery() of Statement returns a RESULTSET object.
Identify the error: executeUpdate("SELECT ...") → B) executeQuery should be used
Fill: The JDBC architecture consists of two main layers: the JDBC API and the JDBC DRIVER (Driver API/Manager layer).
